evaluation.sampling: Last available market session of each W-FRI week
evaluation.outcome: Minimum SPY close over the next 63 sessions is at least 10% below signal-date close
evaluation.important_caveat: The crisis examples motivated these rules before this audit. Yearly stability can reject a fragile rule but cannot create a fresh holdout.

point_in_time.features: Trailing-only z-scores; no future macro values
